why: Each box is cut by an X into 4 triangles, and every box has exactly 2 white triangles. The white triangles all touch the centre of the big square, so together they make one white box (diamond) in the middle. Top-left box: white right and bottom. Top-right box: white left and bottom. Bottom-left box: white top and right. So the bottom-right box needs white top and left triangles = option 3. Option 4 is all black, so the white middle box would be broken.
trick: The white parts of all 4 boxes join to make one white shape in the centre.
note: Top-left box fixed to 2 white triangles, bottom-left gets white right; answer 3 (user confirmed).
